label: TP-Link EAP115-Wall
description: 300 Mbps 2.4 GHz wall-plate access point: one 10/100 uplink plus one 10/100 downlink port, 802.3af PoE in.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: uplink 1x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet port and downlink 1x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet port; IEEE 802.11n/g/b at up to 300 Mbps; PoE IEEE 802.3af. The downlink port is modelled because it is the reason to fit a wall plate instead of a ceiling AP - it passes a wired connection through to whatever is in the room.
